opening.argument: The material promotes joining Forsage.io as an online opportunity and provides a WhatsApp contact number for further information. The title itself describes Forsage as an “opportunity,” consistent with that promotional purpose. But an invitation to make contact does not, on this record, establish a deceptive transaction. The supplied material does not show a specific earnings promise, a payment-for-access condition, a request for credentials, or a recruitment hierarchy. Those limits matter: the promotion alone does not establish the mechanism needed to conclude that the invitation is a scam.
